description: This Java source file defines the EnforcedThingMapper class, responsible for mapping Thing objects with enforcers into BSON documents for indexing in a search system, including flattening JSON structures, handling arrays, and extracting metadata.

classes.name: EnforcedThingMapper
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to map JSON representations of Things with enforcers into BSON documents suitable for search indexing, including handling metadata, flattening, and array pruning.

methods.name: mapThing
methods.description: Public method to map a Thing JSON object with enforcer and policy revision into a BSON Document for indexing.

methods.name: toWriteModel
methods.description: Public method to create a ThingWriteModel from a JSON Thing, enforcer, policy revision, and optional max array size.

methods.name: getGlobalRead
methods.description: Private helper to retrieve subject IDs with read permission from the enforcer and convert to BSON array.

methods.name: pruneArrays
methods.description: Private method to truncate large arrays in the JSON object based on maxArraySize.
